# Mannequiny motion source

`mannequiny-motion.blend` contains the root armature and walk/run animation
actions extracted from Mannequiny v0.4.0 by GDQuest, Luciano Muñoz, and
contributors. Source: https://github.com/gdquest-demos/godot-3d-mannequin

Archived upstream file SHA-256:
`1a1ed14c176e5e60e69f52f517c88627554e517b4548aab504d92a67c6e9ce0c`.

License: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0):
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

Modifications: removed the original mesh, textures, and unused animations;
sampled and retargeted lower- and upper-body joint motion onto the ElseMesh KIRI scan, then corrected the resulting foot position. The original
download is archived separately on D: and was not modified.
